# The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab

> > The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL) reduces poverty through rigorous randomized evaluations and evidence-based policy implementation.

J-PAL is a global research organization that conducts randomized controlled trials to test and scale poverty-reduction programs across multiple sectors including education, health, and social protection. With regional offices in Africa, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, J-PAL partners with governments, NGOs, and international development institutions to translate research findings into actionable policy.

## About J-PAL

- [The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab](https://www.povertyactionlab.org): J-PAL homepage: mission to reduce poverty through evidence-based policy

## Regional Offices

- [J-PAL Africa](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/j-pal-africa): J-PAL Africa regional office at University of Cape Town for sub-Saharan work
- [J-PAL Europe](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/j-pal-europe): J-PAL Europe office at Paris School of Economics for evidence-based policy
- [J-PAL Latin America and Caribbean](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/j-pal-latin-america-and-caribbean): J-PAL LAC regional office at Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile
